measured: bash examples/watch/test.sh prints 'passed 73, failed 0'; every check asserts on a value read back out of a run report, a ledger record, a log line or an exit status, and the gate has a floor under the count as well as a zero-failure condition, so a gutted copy that counts nothing exits 1

all four entry documents validate against examples/end-to-end/schemas/entry.schema.json, and all four payload.watch declarations against examples/watch/schemas/watch.schema.json, using the reference example's one validator

the four entry documents name one intent.workflow_ref, the unit name is read back off all four ledgers and matched against that file, and the four doors carry four actors, four run ids and four correlation ids through it, with every signal of every kind stamped with the run id and the correlation id (missing counts zero across all four doors)

the task specification is the one intent.workflow_ref names and not a default: an envelope pointing at a unit that declares a free attempt class puts f-grunt on the model span where the shipped declaration puts i-fast, with no --unit flag given, and intent.summary reaches the plan line and the receipt
observation.step_kinds is read on every step: a unit declaring three kinds refuses the fourth by name and the run stops rather than observing a step the declaration did not carry
all four emission kinds - span, metric, log record and problem object - are read back off the telemetry adapter's own query surface and counted separately, never as one total
one run reassembles from four independently minted root traces by grouping on run.id: distinct_trace_ids equals the span count and run_id_groups is 1, and no span carries a parent field
a run parked on a person and resumed covers two correlation depths and still returns one group, on the correlation id it was parked with
deliberate breakage: when the resume mints its own run id instead of being re-stamped, run_id_groups falls from 1 to 0 and the resume span is missing from the run

detail is read at the point of decision: the same door at 'steps' emits 4 named lifecycle operations and 4 minted traces, at 'unit' emits 1 of each, and the unmapped model kind is reported at 'steps' and absent at 'unit'

every operation name on the wire is a value of the adapter's published mapping; the mapping carries no row for a model call, so that kind is recorded as unmapped rather than transcribed, and the mapping version is read back off the wire
the mapping description publishes operations and not instruments, asserted on the object the adapter returns

sampling is read at the point of decision: head_percent 100 exports 4 spans and 0 exports none, while the cost total carried on the metrics is identical and non-zero in both, and the problem-object count is identical

a caller cannot narrow the guarantee: an entry adding sampling.retain_errors is refused 422 with the member named, and a rejected run at head_percent 0 still exports its span because the unit's retain_always names outcome:error

redact_additional widens and cannot narrow: the same door with and without task_summary puts '[redacted]' or the caller's text on the wire, while prompt and completion are '[redacted]' in every exported signal of every run
the prompt text appears in zero exported signals and the same content under an unredacted key appears in at least one, which is gap G5 measured in both directions
the declared surface changes what is rendered and not what the platform kept: stream renders 8 of 8 stored events and poll renders 0 of the same 8, from one store

since is read at the watch call: 0 renders 11 events and 2 renders 9, the second being exactly the tail of the first; on a surface declaring replayable_from_position false the same field returns a typed 422 naming the surface while the run still completes and exits 0
the task lifecycle on the ledger is submitted, input-required, working, completed, every name from the published set, and run.py refuses a state outside it
cancellation is negotiated at session open, enforced by the boundary, ends with stop reason cancelled and fewer frames than an uncancelled turn, and reports the terminal state cancelled with exit 3
a ceiling below the plan floor exits 2 with a 402, admits no cell, and is recorded as a problem-object signal and a run.finished event as well as printed

the closed registry refuses the ceiling_micros and exceeded_by_micros extension members on budget-exhausted, so the overage survives only in detail prose; the refusal itself is recorded in the run report
a refused tool call is folded into a ledger record with its rule id and a problem-object signal, and the unit still completes
a malformed envelope exits 2 with a 422 naming the missing field, and writes no ledger and no telemetry
every event type emitted is one of the eight the human-interaction capability publishes; seven of the eight are produced and ask.expired is not

the swap is configuration: the same unit against a second telemetry backend returns identical per-kind counts and identical values for six counters, and the pair differs on adapter name and on semantic_queries_supported

no product or vendor name appears anywhere on the runnable surface - run.py, harnesses.py, test.sh, provenance.json, the schema, the unit, the four entries and every log, report and ledger the visible check writes - counted over more than thirty files rather than one door's stdout; generic English words are not needles, the rule is about naming a product
the ledger chain verifies and a one-character edit is detected
provenance.cites equals exactly the set of ids carried by the example's files and by the proposed blueprint the area also ships, checked in both directions, and FLOOR equals visible_checks_counted
docs/architecture/proposed/watch.json carries six proposed blueprint gaps, every one with a research query and none with an invented mechanism

isolation.egress_allowlist is read at a point of decision: with egress held at allowlist in both arms, one host and two put different lists on the cell-admitted record, and an allowlist that lists nothing is refused document-invalid with no cell admitted

ceilings.cancel_grace_s is read at every turn and not only under --cancel, and the window the boundary accepted is recorded with the floor it was accepted against: two legal graces, 0.5s and 1.25s, put two cancel windows on the dispatch span, on its log record and on the receipt's attribute list against one floor that does not move, and 0.01s is below that floor, which refuses the turn and names it

ceilings.wall_seconds and tools.ceiling_calls are recorded and not only enforced: 5.0s and 9.0s both complete and put two ceilings on the cell-admitted record, 8 and 3 permitted calls both complete and put two permitted counts on the tool span beside one attempted count, while 0.001s ends the unit at the boundary with stop reason terminated and exit 3, and a call ceiling of 0 raises one more typed budget-exhausted refusal at the point of call without ending the run
tools.server_ref is read at bind time: two references give two binding handles on the tool span

pause_for_decision is proved by a same-envelope differential on both doors that declare it - true covers two correlation depths, puts human.ask and human.decided on the stream and returns a decision row; false covers one, renders three fewer events and returns none

every event name on the stream passed the one vocabulary gate: the gate list and the store's stream agree on all four doors, human.ask and human.decided included, and only Observation.event writes to it
every gap reference in the example resolves to a row of the gap table keyed by id rather than by position, and the two assertions guarding the mapping name the gap the mapping is about

produced by 75-watch-author on 2026-09-04; the example-provenance shape has no member for the producing identity, so it is recorded here, which is the same misplacement the run area recorded as its ninth gap
claimed: that switching backends is a configuration change for a real collector or a hosted ingestion API: both adapters measured here run in process, so the swap is proved across two execution models and claimed across two products (README gap G9)
that the standards named hold at the versions given; no specification page was fetched (STATUS row 14)

that the operation names emitted correspond to the conventions' own vocabulary: they are read from this platform's mapping table, which is pinned and versioned locally and carries three rows, and no convention document was fetched to check them against

that a frame count and a stop reason are a faithful account of what happened inside the cell: they are what the boundary receives, and the steps the unit took between two frames are not observable through any operation on file (README gap G1)
that the head sampling decision here stands for a production pipeline's: it is deterministic and taken on the shared path, and no collector-side or tail-based decision was exercised
that a person decided anything: the decision in the paused run is scripted, so the human boundary is measured for its correlation, replay and refusal behaviour and not for what a reviewer would do
that the hidden deciding check for this example exists: the index looks for one outside examples/, which this author's brief did not permit writing (README gap G10)

that a caller's choice of cancel grace changes what the boundary does: every legal window is accepted, recorded and enforced, but the adapter that runs here polls for cancellation faster than its own floor, so no declared window was measured expiring and the outcome is claimed rather than measured (README gap G11)
